limits: No observed graphics result or native driver/allocation failure guarantee.
Relay is RW then RX. Shared original image page briefly needs RWX while the exact decision site is quiescent; unrelated functions may execute on that page.
Every possibly exposed relay and its pinned DLL remain until process exit. Disable does not force an immediate sample count.
OS failures can prevent protection/cache repair. The module disables permanently and reports restart-required rather than promising recovery.
Uncooperative concurrent code patchers and invented callers cannot be synchronized with the native mutex and are unsupported.
Static initialization guard is not a unique renderer generation. Equality is conservative and combined with observed object/thread lifetime.

Claims.Finding: Single MSAA call at11A14F has aligned rel32 operand11A150. Mixed six-argument ABI and native caller-owned resource updates allow a bounded decision wrapper without direct graphics calls.
Native history mutation must run exactly once. The insufficient-history return can leave current unbounded; policy caps its result rather than editing negotiated capability.
Normal decision path updates30560/30564 history; replay22944 bypasses119E90 and restores recorded levels, so policy interception preserves native replay.
Normal render path takesGX+30848 around128100 and unlocks before103440. Complete caller routing provides exact-site quiescence at post-AppUpdate installation.
Replay sets22944 before128100 and clears it after128260; no independent normal policy call is introduced.
Timing uses the same outer mutex for replay/record close. Present-related execution outside it means the shared code page cannot be made non-executable during patching.
Startup128100 finishes before creation of app and timing threads. Verified execution on the app thread with both live matching handles excludes startup during installation.
Application loop invokes App.vtable+32 without owning the presentation mutex. Existing post-original update callback can acquire it in the native order.
Shutdown waits for app thread before closing its handle, then signals timing stop808 and joins/closes timing. Callback thread lifetime plus handles/state bounds installation and passive policy use.
